parsed.why: Universal document exposure: birth-sex-only passports upheld, visa fraud jeopardy, multi-state facility bans with criminal trespass, federal custody conversion policy — tier-1 rules without working remedy, offset only by partial litigation and no identity offence.

Self-ID, conversion ban, functioning police hate recording, no criminalisation or facility rules; negatives are rising street hostility and survey-documented threats (~1 in 5) — social tier-3 risk with recourse, not state exposure.

Sodomy law actively enforced via mass raid and appearance-based convictions, police complicity in vigilante killings, no advocacy permitted, care de facto criminalised, no recognition or recourse — state-tolerated targeting with failed remedy.

Entry-side pride-welcome programme, marriage equality, anti-discrimination statute, mature care, accepting society; offsets are birth-sex custody placement with forced exposure, one unprosecuted hate murder, weak enforcement — friction without universal exclusion.

Court decriminalisation extending constitutionally to gender identity is a real protection, but no statutory recourse, official resistance until forced, one daylight assault, thin social-acceptance record — open questions, no documented traveller-facing exposure.
